about_section.title: Simplify your daily operations and boost your productivity with our comprehensive solutions, designed for professionals.
about_section.paragraph_1: Whether you're equipping an office or a production workshop, we support you every step of the way to make your work environment more pleasant, better organized and noticeably more efficient. Relying on our reliable equipment, high-quality consumables and responsive technical service, you're free to focus on what matters most: the success of your projects.
about_section.paragraph_2: Lighten your days and boost your output with our comprehensive solutions, specially designed for professionals. From office supplies to the most advanced technical equipment, we guide you every step of the way to transform your workspace into a more pleasant, better structured and noticeably more efficient place.
about_section.vision_text: At Office Line, we aspire to be far more than a supplier of office and technical solutions: to inspire a shift in awareness within a society built on human values, and to be a loyal, committed partner even in the most difficult times.
about_section.mission_text: Listening to our customers, supporting them at every stage — from choosing equipment to growing their business — and providing flawless after-sales service.
about_section.values_text: Shared vision, unwavering commitment and customer satisfaction: the foundations of our success since 1993.

why_section.title: Why choose Office Line?
why_section.subtitle: With over three decades of experience, recognized expertise and a dedicated team, Office Line is the ideal choice to equip and support your success.
why_section.forces_text: Exclusive distributor of Trodat (1993) and Trotec (1997), official distributor of Roland DG and ACCO Brands (2008). A network of over 2,000 distributors and a catalog of more than 4,000 products.
why_section.clients_text: 90% of our business is B2B: stationers, office supply retailers, IT resellers, printers, engravers and stamp makers across Algeria.
why_section.services_text: Warranty from 1 to 25 years depending on the product, and qualified after-sales service: installation, repair, training, diagnostics and phone support.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.meta_description: Privacy policy and personal data protection for SARL Office Line.
body: SARL Office Line attaches great importance to protecting your personal data and is committed to handling it with the utmost confidentiality.
Data collected through this site's forms (contact, quote requests, distributor area) is used exclusively to process your request, ensure sales follow-up and improve our services.
This data is never sold, transferred or rented to third parties. It is kept for as long as necessary to process your request and maintain the business relationship.

In accordance with law no. 18-07 of June 10, 2018 on the protection of individuals in the processing of personal data, you have the right to access, rectify and object to your data. To exercise this right, contact us at commercial@officeline-dz.com.
This site may use technical cookies necessary for its proper functioning (language preference, form session). No third-party advertising cookies are used without your consent.

compliance.title: Law 18-07 compliance
compliance.meta_description: SARL Office Line's commitment to compliance with Algerian law 18-07 on personal data protection.
body: Law no. 18-07 of June 10, 2018 on the protection of individuals in the processing of personal data regulates the collection and processing of personal data in Algeria.

SARL Office Line is committed to only collecting data strictly necessary to process your requests (quotes, contact, distributor access), to secure this data, and to never transmit it to any unauthorized third party.

Our Rexel and Ideal document shredders, featured in our Office Supplies catalog, are in fact a concrete response to this law's requirements for the secure destruction of documents containing sensitive data.
For any question regarding the processing of your data or to exercise your rights, our team remains available at commercial@officeline-dz.com.
